title: Wait for the reveal, collect the deliverable, receipt or refund
spec: Add src/payer/settle.ts: settle({ state, ref, surface, feeder, rail, notes, postDeal, judge? }). Subscribe for a reveal naming the contract while collecting non-frame lines from the payee (deal room) or contract-tagged lines in the deliveries room (board surface). On reveal: applyFrame; if ok post a receipt { outcome: "claimed", rail, ref } and move the state note to claimed. On no reveal by refundAfterMs: post a refund frame with reason, call rail.refund(ref). Return { status: claimed|refunded|bad-reveal, deliverables, payee, contract }.
done: Recorded reveal and ghost scenarios end in claimed with the deliverable text and in refunded with a refund frame.
